goal:
Add dcc-text-lands?(text, claims) to cognition/difficult-conversation-counsel.fk so a draft reply's text can be asked whether it lands before it is offered. It must answer exactly dcc-reply-lands?(dc-moves-of(text), claims): 1 for the trail reply with no claims, 0 for the flattering reply, the bare question, and the empty text with no claims, and 0 for every text when the claims include dcc-claim("other", "observed"). It is one expression over dc-moves-of and dcc-reply-lands?, preserving the existing dcc-reply-lands? and its callers.
Definition manifest: dcc-text-lands?
original_goal: In cognition/difficult-conversation-counsel.fk add dcc-text-lands?(text, claims), which answers dcc-reply-lands?(dc-moves-of(text), claims): dcc-text-lands?("I am reading from Sema's own library. I will show you the whole trail whenever you ask. What is it about the woodworking?", []) answers 1, dcc-text-lands?("That is completely normal. You have got this.", []) answers 0, dcc-text-lands?("What do you think?", []) answers 0 and dcc-text-lands?("", []) answers 0. With a claim that states the absent person's interior as observed it answers 0 for every text, as dcc-reply-lands? does. Write it as one expression over dc-moves-of and dcc-reply-lands?.
